content.comment_body: Hello, I'm working with a [product_name] [article_no] in an existing project and I'm concerned about two memory addresses, V0.0 and V3.1. When using the Data Table in Diagram mode online, both addresses show the same value: 2#0, except when V0.0 is "0" and V3.1 is "1". I want to set V3.1 to "0" by entering a new value. Why do the values match? What value should I use to change V3.1 to "0"?
Who is writing to these two addresses? Do you have an HMI or another [product_name] module or any other device in the project?
Issue resolved! I was looking at the incorrect Data Table. Thanks for the support!

analysis.insight_summary: Initially, the user was confused about the current values of certain memory addresses within the Data Table (Diagram mode) of a [product_name] [article_no] project, noticing unexpected similarity between two addresses. The confusion was due to referencing the wrong Data Table, which suggests the software interface could be clearer for users navigating multiple data views.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the Data Table interface to provide a straightforward way to view and manually update individual memory addresses, ensuring each value can be independently verified and modified.
